# Paweł Ostromecki

> Senior software engineer and consultant from Wrocław, Poland, working remotely worldwide. He brings AI into real business processes and builds the software around it: web and mobile apps, websites, audits and maintenance. He leads the Angular Wrocław community.

## Services

- [AI workflows](https://www.ostromecki.dev/services): take a manual, repetitive process such as ordering, ticket triage, document checks or data entry, design an LLM or agent workflow around it, and plug it into the tools a team already uses.
- [AI in real business cases](https://www.ostromecki.dev/services): separate the use cases that pay off from the ones that only demo well, test on real data, and turn the winner into a product people use.
- [Web applications](https://www.ostromecki.dev/services): client portals, admin panels, booking and order systems, and internal tools that replace spreadsheets.
- [Mobile apps](https://www.ostromecki.dev/services): iOS and Android apps from one codebase, or a web app on the phone when that is enough.
- [Websites](https://www.ostromecki.dev/services): company websites and landing pages, fast on a phone and ready for Google and AI search.
- [Application audit](https://www.ostromecki.dev/services): an independent review of code, architecture, security and performance, with fixes ranked by impact.
- [Maintenance and development](https://www.ostromecki.dev/services): fixes, updates, monitoring and new features after launch.

Ways to start with AI: Discovery (1 to 2 weeks), Pilot (4 to 8 weeks). The first 30-minute consultation is free and without commitment.

## Use cases

- [Agentic replenishment for a salon network](https://www.ostromecki.dev/use-cases/salon-replenishment): salons order stock from HQ in plain language, and an AI agent turns the request into a checked proposal.
- [No-code forms for a regulated industry](https://www.ostromecki.dev/use-cases/no-code-forms): a client-owned drag-and-drop platform for compliance forms, worked on as an external contractor.
